name: The Ashenvale Hunt
summary: In Thunder Bluff, the Ashenvale Hunt calls young Horde champions north to serve at the forest outposts. Heralds direct them to report to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post for a proving hunt.

sections.title: A Summons from the High Rise
sections.body: Bluff Runner Windstrider carries an open invitation through Thunder Bluff for proven adventurers. The Horde has established footholds in the ancient forest north of the Barrens, and its outposts need young warriors. Those who answer will face a harsher land and test their survival skills beyond Mulgore.

sections.title: The Northern Frontier
sections.body: Ashenvale offers the Horde rich resources and severe peril. Splintertree Post stands along the main road, while a remote outpost lies on the western coast at Zoram Strand. At Splintertree Post, Senani Thunderheart, a veteran outdoorswoman, organizes a great hunt to tame the wilderness and win glory for the Horde.

faq.q: Who offers this quest in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Bluff Runner Windstrider offers the summons to passing adventurers in Thunder Bluff. He alerts capable fighters to the Horde's efforts to expand and points them toward outposts that need aid.

aliases: how to get to splintertree post
faq.answer: Splintertree Post is a fortified Horde settlement in eastern Ashenvale. Travel north across the Barrens border, then follow the eastern forest trail deeper into the woods.
Senani Thunderheart is a seasoned tauren tracker stationed at Splintertree Post. She organizes hunts in Ashenvale, testing Horde recruits against the local predators.

faq.q: Why is the Horde hunting in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Horde hunts in Ashenvale to gather timber and secure territory. The hunt thins the wild beasts that threaten its camps and lets young adventurers prove themselves in unfamiliar terrain.

faq.q: What is the Zoram Strand mentioned in the briefing?
faq.answer: Zoram Strand is a Horde encampment on Ashenvale's far western coast, facing the sea. It is a secondary naval foothold and a bastion against naga and hostile forest dwellers.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Senani?
faq.answer: When you report to Senani Thunderheart, she welcomes you to the outpost and sets you to the broader hunt, directing you to stalk and conquer Ashenvale's fiercest beasts.

angles.text: As a tauren raised on Mulgore's open plains, you face an unfamiliar challenge beneath Ashenvale's dense, shadowed canopy, watched by kin such as Senani.
As Horde, you rely on Splintertree Post and Zoram Strand to support the northern supply lines. Fresh recruits help keep wild beasts and hostile natives at bay.
As a hunter, you can hone your tracking in Ashenvale's dense woodland, where prowlers move through terrain unlike the dry, open southern savannas.
